title: Cyath
extract:
The Cyath is a  Slash-focused bladed Strike used in Zaw construction.

Acquisition
The Cyath blueprint can be acquired after reaching the Rank of Neutral with the Ostrons and buying it from Hok for  1,000.

Characteristics
This Strike primarily deals  Slash damage.

20%  Impact
5%  Puncture
75%  Slash
Compatible weapon types:

Machete
Polearm

Bugs
A Machete using Cyath as Strike has damage falloff on its Heavy Slam.
